title: Finch Circle Deposit Rate Schedule for Marlowe & Finch Alterations Tickets
content:
The deposit rate on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket is set by the customer's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program.

| Customer | Deposit rate |
|---|---|
| Active member at Finch Circle Platinum or above (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 2500.00 USD or more) | 30 percent |
| Active Finch Circle Gold member (tier qualifying spend threshold 1200.00 USD, below 2500.00 USD) | 40 percent |
| Anyone else, including a customer with no active Finch Circle membership | the class's own deposit percentage |

**Records read.** The tier of the customer's Finch Circle membership and whether the membership is active.

## Both sides of each tier line

| Membership | Deposit rate |
|---|---|
| Active, tier threshold 2500.00 USD (Platinum) | 30 percent |
| Active, tier threshold 1200.00 USD (Gold) | 40 percent |
| Active, tier threshold below 1200.00 USD | the class's own deposit percentage |
| Platinum tier, membership not active | the class's own deposit percentage |

## Hypothetical illustration

For a ticket in a class whose own deposit percentage is 50: an active Platinum member's deposit rate is 30 percent, an active Gold member's 40 percent, and an active Silver member's 50 percent.
